1.2.4.4-n12-c1.reason: Scoffers who misuse and deride their friends fit 'backbiteth not ... nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbour'; the Psalm 16 verses do not fit.

1.2.4.4-p1-ic1621.reason: 'his soul was full of the mocking of the wealthy, and of the despitefulness of the proud' matches 'filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, and with the contempt of the proud.'

1.2.4.4-p2-ic3008.reason: 'cuts like a two-edged sword. They shoot bitter words as arrows' matches 'whet their tongue like a sword… shoot their arrows, even bitter words.'
